verdict.rationale: The official CLI documents a one-liner, `npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills`, that installs a whole skill collection. It supports GitHub shorthand, full URLs, GitLab, Azure and direct URLs, plus non-interactive `-y` and agent targeting (`-a claude-code`). It writes skills into each agent's project or global skills directory, and the spec says agents load available skills at startup, so they are active in the next session. Community comments call it a "really good implementation" but give no concrete hands-on confirmation of next-session activation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that installed skills appear automatically in a new agent session.
